created_prompt:
Create a three-year plan with concrete steps and goals to grow Julie's cooking account online and publish a cookbook. Compare the positives and negatives between traditional vs. self-publishing a cookbook, and lay out steps for each option.

Take into account Julie has limited time and budget to work on this cookbook.

Extra details: Julie currently posts cooking videos to 1.2M followers.
She focuses on quick, healthy recipes. 
She works four days a week on a different job.
